gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: The road ___ at the moment — use the bypass.
gaps.explanation: 'At the moment' — present continuous passive: is being repaired.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ by the time I arrived at the office.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: the sending preceded the arrival.

gaps.sentence: The whole street ___ when the gas main burst.
gaps.explanation: The street was evacuated by others: past necessity had to be + evacuated.

gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.

gaps.sentence: English ___ (speak) as a first language in more than fifty countries.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + spoken. Facts about the language, not about a speaker.
Past simple passive: was + demolished. The demolition company is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: Her memoir ___ (translate) into fourteen languages so far.
gaps.explanation: 'So far' requires present perfect passive: has been + translated (singular 'memoir').
